newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to Watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to Watch.

text.p: * Warner-Lambert Co rose 1/2 to 72-3/4 in London trading after the company reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.63, versus a consensus estimate of $0.62.
* Polaroid Corp reported fourth quarter earnings per operating share of $0.81, compared to a First Call estimate of $0.85 and a loss of $0.01 a year earlier. The stock closed at 43-3/4 Tuesday.
* Knight-Ridder Inc reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.79, compared to $0.32 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.32. Shares closed at 37-5/8.
* Iomega Corp slipped to 18-1/2 in after-hours trading from a Tuesday close at 19. It reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.15, compared to $0.08 a year ago.
* EMC Corp fell to 36-3/4 in after-hours trade from a close of 37-3/4. The company reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.50, versus $0.26 a year ago.
* International Business Machines Corp shares were up 1/4 at 151 in London following sharp gains Tuesday after the company announced a two-for-one stock split.
* Intel Corp was up 1/4 at 151-1/4 in London and Compaq Computer Corp added 1/8 to 84-5/8.
* Bethlehem Steel Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.06, compared to $0.20 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 8-1/2.
* Norfolk Southern Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.61, compared to $1.53 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 86-3/4.

* Ford Motor Co reported fourth quarter earnings per fully diluted share of $0.99, up from $0.48 a year ago. The 1996 figure includes a net charge of $132 million versus a year-ago gain of $101 million. The stock closed at 32-1/2.
